{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=2|time=½ hour|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Mexico|Mexican cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==

* 1 whole dried ancho [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Sugar#Less-refined|piloncillo]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Clove|clove]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] semi-sweet dark [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]] bar, cut into pieces
* 2 cups high-quality [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla bean]] [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]]

==Procedure==

# Wash, devein, and remove seeds from chile ancho.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the chile, then [[Cookbook:Puréeing|blend]] with the smallest amount of water possible.
# Strain off water.
# In a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], add [[Cookbook:Purée|pureed]] chile, piloncillo, clove, cinnamon and chocolate.
# Boil for 3 minutes.
# Remove clove.
# To serve, allow vanilla ice cream to soften slightly in a bowl and stir in mole.
